## Routes (generated by `node packages/naive/src/router/router.ts --md`)

Every route works on one venture, named in front of it: its id, or its folder path for a nested venture (`studio/print`). Record routes read, write, check, view, lay out or show the template of one record type; a collection has a list route and an `[id]` item route; command routes run a venture-wide tool and can be viewed. A write is checked against the record's schema first; a record whose decision class escalates is written as a draft when an agent writes it, for a person to accept.

| `system/signals` | command | run, view, layout | `packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/signals.ts` |  |  | Pull signals: render what new signals in the venture's libraries say into records through its listeners, write each new or changed record as the signal projector, verify an unchanged one, propose decisions and mark records stale; a pull after a pull writes nothing |
| `system/signals/explain` | command | run, view, layout | `packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/signals.ts` |  |  | One signal at every listener: salient or noise, and every failed predicate; input value is the signal id |
| `system/signals/replay` | command | run, view, layout | `packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/signals.ts` |  |  | Render every projected record again from the signals it cites and report drift; writes nothing |

Holds names, routes, sizes, times and tokens; inputs and outputs only when the venture turns on traces.content |
